q_vocab_a1_01_001.question: Che cosa significa 'hola'?
q_vocab_a1_01_001.explanation: 'Hola' è il saluto spagnolo più comune, usato a qualsiasi ora del giorno.

q_vocab_a1_01_002.question: Che cosa significa 'gracias'?
q_vocab_a1_01_002.explanation: 'Gracias' significa 'grazie'. Si può dire 'muchas gracias' per 'grazie mille'.

q_vocab_a1_01_003.question: Buenos ___, ¿cómo estás?
q_vocab_a1_01_003.explanation: 'Buenos días' significa 'buongiorno' ed è un saluto comune usato al mattino.

q_vocab_a1_01_004.question: Che cosa significa 'por favor'?
q_vocab_a1_01_004.explanation: 'Por favor' si usa per fare richieste educate, proprio come 'per favore' in italiano.

q_vocab_a1_01_005.question: Che cosa significa 'lo siento' in 'Lo siento mucho'?
q_vocab_a1_01_005.explanation: 'Lo siento' significa letteralmente 'lo sento', ma si usa per dire 'mi dispiace'. 'Mucho' aggiunge enfasi e significa 'molto'.

q_vocab_a1_01_006.question: A domani!
q_vocab_a1_01_006.explanation: 'Hasta mañana' significa letteralmente 'fino a domani' e si usa quando si vedrà qualcuno il giorno dopo.

q_vocab_a1_01_007.question: Che cosa significa 'de nada' in '¡Gracias! — De nada.'?
q_vocab_a1_01_007.explanation: 'De nada' significa letteralmente 'di niente' ed è la risposta standard a 'gracias'.

q_vocab_a1_01_008.question: ¿Cómo estás?
q_vocab_a1_01_008.explanation: '¿Cómo estás?' è il modo informale di chiedere 'Come stai?'. La forma formale è '¿Cómo está usted?'.

q_vocab_a1_01_009.question: Urti per sbaglio una persona per strada. Che cosa dici?
q_vocab_a1_01_009.explanation: 'Perdón' significa 'scusa' o 'permesso' e si usa quando si disturba qualcuno senza volerlo.

q_vocab_a1_01_010.question: Stai uscendo dalla casa di un amico a tarda notte. Che cosa dici?
q_vocab_a1_01_010.explanation: 'Buenas noches' significa 'buonanotte' e si usa sia come saluto sia come commiato la sera.

q_vocab_a1_02_002.question: Mi ___ se llama Carlos. Es el esposo de mi madre.
q_vocab_a1_02_002.explanation: 'Padre' significa 'father'. Il/la sentence says 'My father è named Carlos. He è il/la husband di my mother.'

q_vocab_a1_02_003.question: Cosa does 'hermana' significare?
q_vocab_a1_02_003.explanation: 'Hermana' è il/la forma femminile significato 'sister'. Il/la forma maschile 'hermano' significa 'brother'.

q_vocab_a1_02_005.question: My uncle lives in Madrid.
q_vocab_a1_02_005.explanation: 'Tío' significa 'uncle'. 'Tía' è il/la forma femminile significato 'aunt'.

q_vocab_a1_02_006.question: Cosa does 'esposa' significare in 'Ella es mi esposa'?
q_vocab_a1_02_006.explanation: 'Esposa' significa 'wife'. 'Esposo' significa 'husband'. Questi sono formale terms per a married partner.

q_vocab_a1_02_007.question: Tu want a introduce il tuo female friend a someone. Quale parola do tu use?
q_vocab_a1_02_007.explanation: 'Amiga' significa 'female friend'. Using 'novia' sarebbe significare 'girlfriend' (romantic partner), quale è different.

q_vocab_a1_02_008.question: Cosa does 'primo' significare in 'Mi primo tiene diez años'?
q_vocab_a1_02_008.explanation: 'Primo' (maschile) significa 'cousin'. 'Prima' è il/la forma femminile. Il/la sentence significa 'My cousin è ten years old'.

q_vocab_a1_02_009.question: Tengo dos hermanos y una hermana.
q_vocab_a1_02_009.correct: I have two brothers and one sister.
wrong: I have two sisters and one brother.
I have two cousins and one sister.
I have two friends and one sister.
q_vocab_a1_02_009.explanation: 'Hermanos' è il/la plurale forma maschile significato 'brothers'. 'Hermana' significa 'sister'.

q_vocab_a1_02_010.question: Il tuo neighbor asks about il tuo family. Come do tu say 'I live con my parents'?
q_vocab_a1_02_010.explanation: 'Padres' significa 'parents'. Esso è il/la plurale di 'padre' (father) ma quando used in plurale esso si riferisce a both parents.

q_vocab_a1_03_001.question: Cosa does 'hora' significare?
q_vocab_a1_03_001.explanation: 'Hora' significa 'hour' o 'tempo' (quando asking cosa tempo esso è). '¿Qué hora es?' = 'Cosa tempo è esso?'

q_vocab_a1_03_002.question: Cosa does 'mañana' significare in 'por la mañana'?
q_vocab_a1_03_002.explanation: 'Mañana' significa 'morning' quando used con 'por la'. Esso può anche significare 'tomorrow' in other contexts.

q_vocab_a1_03_003.question: Son las tres y ___. (3:30)
q_vocab_a1_03_003.explanation: 'Media' significa 'half'. 'Son las tres y media' significa 'Esso è three thirty' (literally 'three e a half').

q_vocab_a1_03_004.question: Cosa does 'reloj' significare?
q_vocab_a1_03_004.explanation: 'Reloj' può significare both 'clock' (wall clock) e 'watch' (wristwatch) in spagnolo.

q_vocab_a1_03_005.question: Cosa does 'en punto' significare in 'Son las cinco en punto'?
q_vocab_a1_03_005.explanation: 'En punto' significa 'on il/la dot' o 'sharp'. 'Son las cinco en punto' = 'Esso è exactly five o'clock'.

q_vocab_a1_03_006.question: Esso è one o'clock.
q_vocab_a1_03_006.explanation: Per 1:00, we use 'Es la una' (singolare). Per tutti other hours, we use 'Son las...' (plurale).

q_vocab_a1_03_007.question: Cosa does 'tarde' significare in 'Buenas tardes'?
q_vocab_a1_03_007.explanation: 'Tarde' significa 'afternoon'. 'Buenas tardes' si usa roughly da noon fino a sunset.

q_vocab_a1_03_008.question: ¿Qué hora es? — Son las dos y cuarto.
q_vocab_a1_03_008.correct: What time is it? — It is 2:15.
wrong: What time is it? — It is 2:45.
What time is it? — It is 2:30.
What day is it? — It is Tuesday.
q_vocab_a1_03_008.explanation: 'Cuarto' significa 'quarter'. 'Son las dos y cuarto' = 'Esso è two fifteen' (a quarter past two).

q_vocab_a1_03_009.question: Tu need a ask a stranger on il/la street cosa tempo esso è. Cosa do tu say?
q_vocab_a1_03_009.explanation: 'Perdone, ¿qué hora es?' è a polite way a ask someone il/la tempo. 'Perdone' è il/la formale form di 'excuse me'.

q_vocab_a1_03_010.question: Il tuo friend asks quando tu di solito wake up. Come do tu say 'I wake up a seven in il/la morning'?
q_vocab_a1_03_010.correct: Me despierto a las siete de la mañana.
wrong: Me despierto a las siete de la noche.
Me despierto a la siete de la mañana.
Me duermo a las siete de la mañana.
q_vocab_a1_03_010.explanation: 'A las siete de la mañana' significa 'a seven in il/la morning'. Note: we use 'a las' per tutti hours except one ('a la una').

q_vocab_a1_04_001.question: Cosa does 'lunes' significare?
q_vocab_a1_04_001.explanation: 'Lunes' significa 'Monday'. In spagnolo, days di il/la week sono not capitalized.

q_vocab_a1_04_002.question: El primer mes del año es ___.
q_vocab_a1_04_002.explanation: 'Enero' significa 'January', il/la first month di il/la year. Like days, months sono not capitalized in spagnolo.

q_vocab_a1_04_003.question: Cosa does 'verano' significare?
q_vocab_a1_04_003.explanation: 'Verano' significa 'summer'. Il/la four seasons sono: primavera (spring), verano (summer), otoño (autumn), invierno (winter).

q_vocab_a1_04_005.question: Saturday e Sunday
q_vocab_a1_04_005.explanation: 'Sábado' è Saturday e 'domingo' è Sunday. Together loro form il/la 'fin de semana' (weekend).

q_vocab_a1_04_006.question: Cosa does 'primavera' significare in 'Me gusta la primavera'?
q_vocab_a1_04_006.explanation: 'Primavera' significa 'spring'. Il/la sentence significa 'I like spring'.

q_vocab_a1_04_007.question: Someone asks tu cosa day esso è. Today è Wednesday. Come do tu answer?
q_vocab_a1_04_007.explanation: 'Miércoles' significa 'Wednesday'. Note il/la accent mark on il/la 'e'. 'Hoy es...' significa 'Today è...'.

q_vocab_a1_04_008.question: Cosa does 'invierno' significare in 'En invierno hace frío'?
q_vocab_a1_04_008.explanation: 'Invierno' significa 'winter'. Il/la sentence significa 'In winter esso è cold'.

q_vocab_a1_04_009.question: Hoy es viernes. Mañana es ___.
q_vocab_a1_04_009.correct: Today is Friday. Tomorrow is Saturday.
wrong: Today is Friday. Tomorrow is Thursday.
Today is Friday. Tomorrow is Sunday.
Today is Thursday. Tomorrow is Friday.
q_vocab_a1_04_009.explanation: 'Viernes' è Friday e il/la day dopo Friday è 'sábado' (Saturday).

q_vocab_a1_04_010.question: Tu want a schedule a meeting. Come do tu say 'Il/la meeting è on Thursday'?
q_vocab_a1_04_010.explanation: Days di il/la week use il/la articolo 'el' (singolare) o 'los' (plurale/habitual). 'El jueves' = 'on Thursday'.

q_vocab_a1_05_001.question: Cosa does 'rojo' significare?
q_vocab_a1_05_001.explanation: 'Rojo' significa 'red'. Like la maggior parte adjectives, esso changes form: rojo (masc.), roja (fem.).

q_vocab_a1_05_003.question: El cielo es ___. (Il/la sky è ___)
q_vocab_a1_05_003.explanation: 'Azul' significa 'blue'. Unlike la maggior parte color adjectives, 'azul' does not change per maschile/femminile.

q_vocab_a1_05_004.question: Cosa does 'negro' significare?
q_vocab_a1_05_004.explanation: 'Negro' significa 'black'. Esso follows regolare aggettivo agreement: negro (masc.), negra (fem.).

q_vocab_a1_05_005.question: Cosa does 'amarillo' significare in 'El sol es amarillo'?
q_vocab_a1_05_005.explanation: 'Amarillo' significa 'yellow'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la sun è yellow'.

q_vocab_a1_05_006.question: Il/la car è green.
q_vocab_a1_05_006.explanation: 'Verde' significa 'green'. 'Coche' (car) è maschile, so we use 'el'. 'Verde' does not change per gender.

q_vocab_a1_05_007.question: Cosa does 'gris' significare in 'El gato es gris'?
q_vocab_a1_05_007.explanation: 'Gris' significa 'grey'. Like 'azul' e 'verde', esso does not change form per maschile/femminile.

q_vocab_a1_05_008.question: ¿De qué color es la naranja?
q_vocab_a1_05_008.explanation: '¿De qué color es...?' significa 'Cosa color è...?' Questo è il/la standard way a ask about colors in spagnolo.

q_vocab_a1_05_009.question: Tu sono shopping per clothes e want a ask if a shirt comes in pink. Cosa do tu say?
q_vocab_a1_05_009.explanation: 'Rosa' significa 'pink'. '¿Tiene... en rosa?' è a natural way a ask if something comes in pink.

q_vocab_a1_05_010.question: A friend asks tu il tuo favorite color. Come do tu say 'My favorite color è blue'?
q_vocab_a1_05_010.correct: Mi color favorito es el azul.
wrong: Mi color favorito es el rojo.
Mi color favorita es la azul.
Mi color favorito es el verde.
q_vocab_a1_05_010.explanation: 'Color' è maschile, so we say 'favorito' (not 'favorita'). 'Azul' significa 'blue'.

q_vocab_a1_06_001.question: Cosa does 'agua' significare?
q_vocab_a1_06_001.explanation: 'Agua' significa 'water'. Despite being femminile, esso uses 'el' in singolare: 'el agua' (a avoid two 'a' sounds together).

q_vocab_a1_06_002.question: Quiero un ___ con leche, por favor.
q_vocab_a1_06_002.explanation: 'Café con leche' significa 'coffee con milk', a molto popular drink in Spain e Latin America.

q_vocab_a1_06_003.question: Cosa does 'pan' significare?
q_vocab_a1_06_003.explanation: 'Pan' significa 'bread'. Esso è one di il/la la maggior parte basic food items in spagnolo-speaking countries.

q_vocab_a1_06_004.question: Cosa does 'pollo' significare?
q_vocab_a1_06_004.explanation: 'Pollo' significa 'chicken'. 'Carne' è il/la general parola per 'meat'.

q_vocab_a1_06_005.question: Voglio un bicchiere di succo d'arancia.
q_vocab_a1_06_005.correct: Quiero un vaso de zumo de naranja.
wrong: Quiero un vaso de leche de naranja.
Quiero una taza de zumo de naranja.
Quiero un vaso de vino de naranja.
q_vocab_a1_06_005.explanation: 'Zumo' significa 'succo' (usato in Spagna; in America Latina si usa 'jugo'). 'Vaso' significa 'bicchiere'.

q_vocab_a1_06_006.question: Cosa does 'pescado' significare in 'El pescado está fresco'?
q_vocab_a1_06_006.explanation: 'Pescado' si riferisce a fish as food. 'Pez' è a living fish. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la fish è fresh'.

q_vocab_a1_06_007.question: Tu sono a a restaurant e il/la waiter asks cosa tu want a drink. Come do tu order a beer?
q_vocab_a1_06_007.explanation: 'Cerveza' significa 'beer'. 'Una cerveza, por favor' è a polite way a order a beer a a restaurant.

q_vocab_a1_06_008.question: Cosa does 'ensalada' significare in 'La ensalada está rica'?
q_vocab_a1_06_008.explanation: 'Ensalada' significa 'salad'. 'Rica' qui significa 'delicious'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la salad è delicious'.

q_vocab_a1_06_009.question: Me gustan las frutas y las verduras.
q_vocab_a1_06_009.explanation: 'Frutas' significa 'fruits' e 'verduras' significa 'vegetables'. 'Me gustan' si usa con plurale nouns.

q_vocab_a1_06_010.question: Tu sono a guest a a Spagnolo home e il/la host offers tu food. Come do tu politely accept?
q_vocab_a1_06_010.correct: Sí, gracias. Tiene muy buena pinta.
wrong: No me gusta la comida española.
q_vocab_a1_06_010.explanation: 'Tiene muy buena pinta' significa 'Esso looks molto good'. Questo è un polite e appreciative way a accept food.

q_vocab_a1_07_001.question: Cosa does 'cabeza' significare?
q_vocab_a1_07_001.explanation: 'Cabeza' significa 'head'. 'Me duele la cabeza' significa 'My head hurts' (I avere a headache).

q_vocab_a1_07_002.question: Cosa does 'mano' significare?
q_vocab_a1_07_002.explanation: 'Mano' significa 'hand'. Note: despite che termina in -o, 'mano' è femminile (la mano).

q_vocab_a1_07_003.question: No puedo caminar, me duele el ___.
q_vocab_a1_07_003.explanation: 'Pie' significa 'foot'. Il/la sentence says 'I cannot walk, my foot hurts'.

q_vocab_a1_07_004.question: Cosa does 'ojo' significare?
q_vocab_a1_07_004.explanation: 'Ojo' significa 'eye'. Il/la plurale è 'ojos'. 'Tiene los ojos azules' = 'He/She ha blue eyes'.

q_vocab_a1_07_005.question: Cosa does 'espalda' significare in 'Me duele la espalda'?
q_vocab_a1_07_005.explanation: 'Espalda' significa 'back' (body part). Il/la sentence significa 'My back hurts'.

q_vocab_a1_07_006.question: I brush my teeth ogni morning.
q_vocab_a1_07_006.correct: Me lavo los dientes cada mañana.
wrong: Me lavo las manos cada mañana.
Me lavo el pelo cada mañana.
Me lavo los ojos cada mañana.
q_vocab_a1_07_006.explanation: 'Dientes' significa 'teeth' (singolare: 'diente'). In spagnolo, we say 'lavarse los dientes' (wash il/la teeth) rather than 'brush'.

q_vocab_a1_07_007.question: Cosa does 'boca' significare in 'Abre la boca'?
q_vocab_a1_07_007.explanation: 'Boca' significa 'mouth'. 'Abre la boca' significa 'Open il tuo mouth', commonly heard a il/la dentist.

q_vocab_a1_07_008.question: Tengo el pelo largo y los ojos marrones.
q_vocab_a1_07_008.correct: I have long hair and brown eyes.
wrong: I have short hair and blue eyes.
I have long arms and brown eyes.
I have long hair and green eyes.
q_vocab_a1_07_008.explanation: 'Pelo' significa 'hair', 'largo' significa 'long', e 'ojos marrones' significa 'brown eyes'.

q_vocab_a1_07_009.question: Tu sono a il/la doctor's office e need per dire dove esso hurts. Come do tu say 'My stomach hurts'?
q_vocab_a1_07_009.explanation: 'Estómago' significa 'stomach'. 'Me duele' si usa per singolare body parts quello hurt.

q_vocab_a1_07_010.question: Tu sono describing a friend's appearance. Come do tu say 'She ha big ears e a small nose'?
q_vocab_a1_07_010.correct: Tiene las orejas grandes y la nariz pequeña.
wrong: Tiene los ojos grandes y la boca pequeña.
Tiene las orejas pequeñas y la nariz grande.
Tiene las manos grandes y los pies pequeños.
q_vocab_a1_07_010.explanation: 'Orejas' significa 'ears' e 'nariz' significa 'nose'. In spagnolo, we use 'tener' (a avere) per descrivere physical features.

q_vocab_a1_08_001.question: Cosa does 'zapatos' significare?
q_vocab_a1_08_001.explanation: 'Zapatos' significa 'shoes' (singolare: 'zapato'). 'Un par de zapatos' = 'a pair di shoes'.

q_vocab_a1_08_002.question: Hace frío, necesito mi ___.
q_vocab_a1_08_002.explanation: 'Abrigo' significa 'coat'. Il/la sentence says 'Esso's cold, I need my coat'.

q_vocab_a1_08_003.question: Cosa does 'camisa' significare?
q_vocab_a1_08_003.explanation: 'Camisa' significa 'shirt' (tipicamente a formale/button-up shirt). A 'camiseta' è a t-shirt.

q_vocab_a1_08_004.question: Cosa does 'vestido' significare?
q_vocab_a1_08_004.explanation: 'Vestido' significa 'dress'. Esso comes da il verbo 'vestir' (a dress/a wear).

q_vocab_a1_08_005.question: I am wearing black pants.
q_vocab_a1_08_005.explanation: 'Pantalones' significa 'pants/trousers'. 'Llevar' è commonly used per 'a wear' in spagnolo.

q_vocab_a1_08_006.question: Cosa does 'bolso' significare in 'Llevo mi bolso al trabajo'?
q_vocab_a1_08_006.explanation: 'Bolso' significa 'bag' o 'handbag'. Il/la sentence significa 'I take my bag a work'.

q_vocab_a1_08_007.question: Tu sono going a il/la beach. Quale item sarebbe tu NOT tipicamente bring?
q_vocab_a1_08_007.explanation: 'Botas' significa 'boots', quale sono not typical beach wear. 'Gafas' (glasses/sunglasses) e 'sombrero' (hat) sono useful a il/la beach.

q_vocab_a1_08_008.question: Cosa does 'falda' significare in 'La falda es roja'?
q_vocab_a1_08_008.explanation: 'Falda' significa 'skirt'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la skirt è red'.

q_vocab_a1_08_009.question: Necesito un cinturón para estos pantalones.
q_vocab_a1_08_009.correct: I need a belt for these pants.
wrong: I need a jacket for these pants.
I need socks for these shoes.
I need a hat for this dress.
q_vocab_a1_08_009.explanation: 'Cinturón' significa 'belt'. Il/la sentence significa tu need a belt perché il/la pants sono too loose.

q_vocab_a1_08_010.question: Tu sono a a clothing store e want a try on a jacket. Cosa do tu say?
q_vocab_a1_08_010.explanation: 'Probarme' significa 'a try on'. 'Chaqueta' significa 'jacket'. Questo è un polite way a ask a try on clothing.

q_vocab_a1_09_001.question: Cosa does 'cocina' significare?
q_vocab_a1_09_001.explanation: 'Cocina' significa 'kitchen'. Esso può anche significare 'cooking' o 'stove' depending on context.

q_vocab_a1_09_002.question: Cosa does 'ventana' significare?
q_vocab_a1_09_002.explanation: 'Ventana' significa 'window'. 'Abrir la ventana' = 'a open il/la window'.

q_vocab_a1_09_003.question: Duermo en la ___ todas las noches.
q_vocab_a1_09_003.explanation: 'Cama' significa 'bed'. Il/la sentence says 'I sleep in il/la bed ogni night'.

q_vocab_a1_09_004.question: Cosa does 'puerta' significare?
q_vocab_a1_09_004.explanation: 'Puerta' significa 'door'. 'Abrir la puerta' = 'a open il/la door', 'cerrar la puerta' = 'a close il/la door'.

q_vocab_a1_09_005.question: Che cosa significa 'sofá' in 'Me siento en el sofá'?
q_vocab_a1_09_005.explanation: 'Sofá' significa 'divano'. La frase significa 'Mi siedo sul divano'. Di solito si trova nel 'salón' (soggiorno).

q_vocab_a1_09_006.question: Il/la mirror è in il/la bathroom.
q_vocab_a1_09_006.correct: El espejo está en el baño.
wrong: El espejo está en la cocina.
La lámpara está en el baño.
El armario está en el baño.
q_vocab_a1_09_006.explanation: 'Espejo' significa 'mirror' e 'baño' significa 'bathroom'. We use 'está' per location.

q_vocab_a1_09_007.question: Cosa does 'armario' significare in 'La ropa está en el armario'?
q_vocab_a1_09_007.explanation: 'Armario' significa 'wardrobe' o 'closet'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la clothes sono in il/la wardrobe'.

q_vocab_a1_09_008.question: Hay una estantería con muchos libros en el salón.
q_vocab_a1_09_008.correct: There is a bookshelf with many books in the living room.
wrong: There is a table with many books in the kitchen.
There is a bookshelf with many books in the bedroom.
There is a lamp with many books in the living room.
q_vocab_a1_09_008.explanation: 'Estantería' significa 'bookshelf/shelving unit' e 'salón' significa 'living room'. 'Hay' significa 'C'è/Ci sono'.

q_vocab_a1_09_009.question: Tu sono looking per an apartment e want a ask if esso ha a garden. Cosa do tu say?
q_vocab_a1_09_009.explanation: 'Jardín' significa 'garden'. 'Piso' significa 'apartment' in Spain. Questo è un comune question quando apartment hunting.

q_vocab_a1_09_010.question: A friend è visiting il tuo home. Come do tu say 'Il/la bedroom è next a il/la bathroom'?
q_vocab_a1_09_010.correct: El dormitorio está al lado del baño.
wrong: El dormitorio está lejos del baño.
La cocina está al lado del baño.
El dormitorio está en el baño.
q_vocab_a1_09_010.explanation: 'Dormitorio' significa 'bedroom', 'al lado de' significa 'next a', e 'baño' significa 'bathroom'.

q_vocab_a1_10_002.question: El estudiante escribe en el ___.
q_vocab_a1_10_002.explanation: 'Cuaderno' significa 'notebook'. Il/la sentence says 'Il/la student writes in il/la notebook'.

q_vocab_a1_10_003.question: Cosa does 'profesor' significare?
q_vocab_a1_10_003.explanation: 'Profesor' significa 'teacher' o 'professor'. Il/la forma femminile è 'profesora'.

q_vocab_a1_10_004.question: Cosa does 'examen' significare?
q_vocab_a1_10_004.explanation: 'Examen' significa 'exam' o 'test'. Il/la plurale è 'exámenes' (note il/la accent shift).

q_vocab_a1_10_006.question: Cosa does 'pizarra' significare in 'El profesor escribe en la pizarra'?
q_vocab_a1_10_006.explanation: 'Pizarra' significa 'blackboard' o 'whiteboard'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la teacher writes on il/la board'.

q_vocab_a1_10_007.question: Tu forgot a do il tuo homework. Come do tu tell il tuo teacher?
q_vocab_a1_10_007.correct: Lo siento, no tengo la tarea.
wrong: Lo siento, no tengo el libro.
Lo siento, no tengo el bolígrafo.
Lo siento, no tengo el examen.
q_vocab_a1_10_007.explanation: 'Tarea' significa 'homework' o 'assignment'. 'Deberes' è anche used in Spain per homework.

q_vocab_a1_10_008.question: Cosa does 'lápiz' significare in 'Necesito un lápiz'?
q_vocab_a1_10_008.explanation: 'Lápiz' significa 'pencil'. Il/la plurale è 'lápices'. A pen è 'bolígrafo' (o 'boli' informally).

q_vocab_a1_10_009.question: Mi hermana estudia en la universidad.
q_vocab_a1_10_009.correct: My sister studies at the university.
wrong: My sister studies at the school.
My brother studies at the university.
My sister works at the university.
q_vocab_a1_10_009.explanation: 'Universidad' significa 'university'. 'Estudiar en la universidad' = 'a study a university'.

q_vocab_a1_10_010.question: Tu need a borrow a pen da a classmate. Cosa do tu say?
q_vocab_a1_10_010.explanation: 'Bolígrafo' significa 'pen'. '¿Me prestas...?' significa 'Può tu lend me...?' quale è comune among classmates.

q_vocab_a1_11_001.question: Cosa does 'médico' significare?
q_vocab_a1_11_001.explanation: 'Médico' significa 'doctor'. Il/la forma femminile è 'médica'. 'Doctor/Doctora' è anche commonly used.

q_vocab_a1_11_003.question: El ___ prepara la comida en el restaurante.
q_vocab_a1_11_003.explanation: 'Cocinero' significa 'cook/chef'. Il/la sentence says 'Il/la cook prepares il/la food in il/la restaurant'.

q_vocab_a1_11_004.question: Cosa does 'enfermero' significare?
q_vocab_a1_11_004.explanation: 'Enfermero' significa 'nurse' (male). 'Enfermera' è il/la forma femminile. Loro work in hospitals e clinics.

q_vocab_a1_11_005.question: Cosa does 'periodista' significare in 'El periodista trabaja en un periódico'?
q_vocab_a1_11_005.explanation: 'Periodista' significa 'journalist'. Questo parola è il/la same per maschile e femminile. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la journalist works a a newspaper'.

q_vocab_a1_11_006.question: My father è an engineer.
q_vocab_a1_11_006.explanation: 'Ingeniero' significa 'engineer'. In spagnolo, professions dopo 'ser' tipicamente don't use an articolo (no 'un').

q_vocab_a1_11_007.question: Cosa does 'camarero' significare in 'El camarero trae la cuenta'?
q_vocab_a1_11_007.explanation: 'Camarero' significa 'waiter'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la waiter brings il/la bill'. 'Camarera' è a waitress.

q_vocab_a1_11_008.question: Soy estudiante de medicina. Quiero ser médico.
q_vocab_a1_11_008.correct: I am a medical student. I want to be a doctor.
wrong: I am a law student. I want to be a lawyer.
I am a medical student. I want to be a nurse.
I am an art student. I want to be a doctor.
q_vocab_a1_11_008.explanation: 'Estudiante de medicina' significa 'medical student'. 'Quiero ser' significa 'I want a essere'.

q_vocab_a1_11_009.question: Tu meet someone a a party e loro ask cosa tu do. Come do tu say 'I am a teacher'?
q_vocab_a1_11_009.explanation: We use 'soy' (not 'estoy') per professions perché loro sono considered permanent traits. No articolo è necessario prima il/la profession.

q_vocab_a1_11_010.question: Tu call emergency services. Come do tu ask per il/la police?
q_vocab_a1_11_010.explanation: 'Policía' può significare 'police' (il/la force) o 'police officer'. Qui esso si riferisce a calling il/la police.

q_vocab_a1_12_001.question: Cosa does 'sol' significare?
q_vocab_a1_12_001.explanation: 'Sol' significa 'sun'. 'Hace sol' significa 'Esso è sunny' (literally 'Esso makes sun').

q_vocab_a1_12_002.question: Hoy no hay ___, el cielo está azul.
q_vocab_a1_12_002.explanation: 'Nubes' significa 'clouds' (singolare: 'nube'). Il/la sentence says 'Today Non ci sono clouds, il/la sky è blue'.

q_vocab_a1_12_003.question: Cosa does 'lluvia' significare?
q_vocab_a1_12_003.explanation: 'Lluvia' significa 'rain'. Il verbo form è 'llover' (a rain): 'Está lloviendo' = 'Esso è raining'.

q_vocab_a1_12_004.question: Cosa does 'árbol' significare?
q_vocab_a1_12_004.explanation: 'Árbol' significa 'tree'. Il/la plurale è 'árboles'. 'Bosque' significa 'forest' (molti trees).

q_vocab_a1_12_005.question: Esso è molto cold today e esso è snowing.
q_vocab_a1_12_005.correct: Hoy hace mucho frío y está nevando.
wrong: Hoy hace mucho calor y está nevando.
Hoy hace mucho frío y está lloviendo.
Hoy hace mucho viento y está nevando.
q_vocab_a1_12_005.explanation: 'Frío' significa 'cold', 'nieve' significa 'snow', e 'nevar' significa 'a snow'. 'Está nevando' = 'esso è snowing'.

q_vocab_a1_12_006.question: Cosa does 'montaña' significare in 'Vamos a la montaña este fin de semana'?
q_vocab_a1_12_006.explanation: 'Montaña' significa 'mountain'. Il/la sentence significa 'We sono going a il/la mountain questo weekend'.

q_vocab_a1_12_007.question: Tu want a go a il/la beach. Cosa weather do tu hope per?
q_vocab_a1_12_007.explanation: 'Hace sol y calor' significa 'Esso è sunny e hot'. Questo è ideal beach weather. 'Calor' significa 'heat/hot'.

q_vocab_a1_12_008.question: Cosa does 'río' significare in 'El río es muy largo'?
q_vocab_a1_12_008.explanation: 'Río' significa 'river'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la river è molto long'. 'Mar' significa 'sea'.

q_vocab_a1_12_009.question: Las flores son muy bonitas en primavera.
q_vocab_a1_12_009.correct: The flowers are very pretty in spring.
wrong: The trees are very pretty in spring.
The flowers are very pretty in summer.
The flowers are very big in spring.
q_vocab_a1_12_009.explanation: 'Flores' significa 'flowers' (singolare: 'flor'). 'Bonitas' significa 'pretty'. Flowers tipicamente bloom in 'primavera' (spring).

q_vocab_a1_12_010.question: Tu sono watching il/la weather forecast e want a know about tomorrow. Come do tu ask 'Cosa sarà il/la weather essere like tomorrow?'
q_vocab_a1_12_010.explanation: 'Tiempo' qui significa 'weather' (esso può anche significare 'tempo'). '¿Qué tiempo hará?' uses il/la future tense di 'hacer'.

q_vocab_a1_13_001.question: Cosa does 'coche' significare?
q_vocab_a1_13_001.explanation: 'Coche' significa 'car'. In Latin America, 'carro' o 'auto' sono more commonly used.

q_vocab_a1_13_002.question: Cosa does 'avión' significare?
q_vocab_a1_13_002.explanation: 'Avión' significa 'airplane'. 'Aeropuerto' significa 'airport'. 'Viajar en avión' = 'a travel da plane'.

q_vocab_a1_13_003.question: Voy al trabajo en ___ porque no tengo coche.
q_vocab_a1_13_003.explanation: 'Autobús' significa 'bus'. Il/la sentence says 'I go a work da bus perché I don't avere a car'.

q_vocab_a1_13_004.question: Cosa does 'bicicleta' significare?
q_vocab_a1_13_004.explanation: 'Bicicleta' significa 'bicycle'. Esso è spesso shortened a 'bici' in casual speech.

q_vocab_a1_13_005.question: Cosa does 'metro' significare in 'Tomo el metro para ir al centro'?
q_vocab_a1_13_005.explanation: 'Metro' significa 'subway' o 'metro'. Il/la sentence significa 'I take il/la metro a go a il/la center (downtown)'.

q_vocab_a1_13_006.question: Vado a scuola a piedi.
q_vocab_a1_13_006.correct: Voy a la escuela a pie.
wrong: Voy a la escuela en coche.
Voy a la escuela en tren.
Voy a la escuela en moto.
q_vocab_a1_13_006.explanation: 'A pie' significa 'a piedi'. In questo contesto si dice 'ir a pie' (andare a piedi) e non 'caminar a'.

q_vocab_a1_13_007.question: Cosa does 'tren' significare in 'El tren sale a las ocho'?
q_vocab_a1_13_007.explanation: 'Tren' significa 'train'. Il/la sentence significa 'Il/la train leaves a eight'. 'Estación de tren' = 'train station'.

q_vocab_a1_13_008.question: Quiero viajar a la isla en barco.
q_vocab_a1_13_008.correct: I want to travel to the island by boat.
wrong: I want to travel to the island by plane.
I want to travel to the city by boat.
I want to travel to the island by train.
q_vocab_a1_13_008.explanation: 'Barco' significa 'boat' o 'ship'. 'Isla' significa 'island'. 'En barco' significa 'da boat'.

q_vocab_a1_13_009.question: Tu need a get a il/la airport quickly. Cosa è il/la best option?
q_vocab_a1_13_009.explanation: 'Taxi' è il/la same parola in spagnolo e Inglese. A taxi è il/la fastest e la maggior parte practical way a get a il/la airport.

q_vocab_a1_13_010.question: Il tuo friend asks come tu commute a work. Come do tu say 'I ride my motorcycle a work'?
q_vocab_a1_13_010.explanation: 'Moto' è short per 'motocicleta' (motorcycle). 'En moto' significa 'da motorcycle'. 'Ir en moto' è il/la natural expression.

q_vocab_a1_14_001.question: Cosa does 'comer' significare?
q_vocab_a1_14_001.explanation: 'Comer' significa 'a eat'. 'La comida' significa 'il/la food' o 'il/la meal' (specialmente lunch in Spain).

q_vocab_a1_14_002.question: Me gusta ___ libros por la noche.
q_vocab_a1_14_002.explanation: 'Leer' significa 'a read'. Il/la sentence says 'I like a read books a night'.

q_vocab_a1_14_003.question: Cosa does 'dormir' significare?
q_vocab_a1_14_003.explanation: 'Dormir' significa 'a sleep'. Esso è a verbo con alternanza vocalica: duermo, duermes, duerme...

q_vocab_a1_14_004.question: Cosa does 'hablar' significare?
q_vocab_a1_14_004.explanation: 'Hablar' significa 'a speak' o 'a talk'. 'Hablar español' = 'a speak Spagnolo'.

q_vocab_a1_14_005.question: I open il/la window ogni morning.
q_vocab_a1_14_005.explanation: 'Abrir' significa 'a open'. 'Abro' è il/la first persona singolare (yo) form. Its opposite è 'cerrar' (a close).

q_vocab_a1_14_006.question: Cosa does 'escribir' significare in 'Escribo un correo electrónico'?
q_vocab_a1_14_006.explanation: 'Escribir' significa 'a write'. Il/la sentence significa 'I write an email'. 'Correo electrónico' = 'email'.

q_vocab_a1_14_007.question: Tu sono a a bus stop e il/la bus è late. Cosa verbo descrive cosa tu sono doing?
q_vocab_a1_14_007.explanation: 'Esperar' significa 'a wait'. 'Estoy esperando el autobús' = 'I am waiting per il/la bus'.

q_vocab_a1_14_008.question: Cosa does 'beber' significare in '¿Quieres beber algo?'?
q_vocab_a1_14_008.explanation: 'Beber' significa 'a drink'. Il/la sentence significa 'Do tu want a drink something?' 'Tomar' è anche used per 'a drink'.

q_vocab_a1_14_009.question: Me levanto a las siete y me ducho antes de desayunar.
q_vocab_a1_14_009.correct: I get up at seven and I shower before having breakfast.
wrong: I go to bed at seven and I shower before dinner.
I get up at seven and I eat before showering.
I get up at eight and I shower before having breakfast.
q_vocab_a1_14_009.explanation: 'Levantarse' significa 'a get up', 'ducharse' significa 'a shower', e 'desayunar' significa 'a avere breakfast'.

q_vocab_a1_14_010.question: Il tuo phone rings during a meeting. Come do tu tell il tuo colleagues cosa tu need a do?
q_vocab_a1_14_010.explanation: 'Llamar' significa 'a call'. 'Llamar por teléfono' significa 'a make a phone call'. Esso può anche significare 'a call/name'.

q_vocab_a1_15_001.question: Cosa does 'contento' significare?
q_vocab_a1_15_001.explanation: 'Contento' significa 'happy' o 'pleased'. Il/la forma femminile è 'contenta'. Similar a 'feliz' ma less intense.

q_vocab_a1_15_002.question: Cosa does 'triste' significare?
q_vocab_a1_15_002.explanation: 'Triste' significa 'sad'. Unlike molti adjectives, esso ha il/la same form per maschile e femminile.

q_vocab_a1_15_003.question: Estoy muy ___ después de trabajar todo el día.
q_vocab_a1_15_003.explanation: 'Cansado' significa 'tired'. Il/la sentence says 'I am molto tired dopo working tutti day'. Use 'estar' per temporary states.

q_vocab_a1_15_004.question: Cosa does 'enfermo' significare?
q_vocab_a1_15_004.explanation: 'Enfermo' significa 'sick' o 'ill'. 'Estoy enfermo' = 'I am sick'. Il/la forma femminile è 'enferma'.

q_vocab_a1_15_005.question: Cosa does 'preocupado' significare in 'Estoy preocupado por el examen'?
q_vocab_a1_15_005.explanation: 'Preocupado' significa 'worried'. Il/la sentence significa 'I am worried about il/la exam'. 'Preocuparse' = 'a worry'.

q_vocab_a1_15_006.question: I am molto nervous about il/la interview.
q_vocab_a1_15_006.correct: Estoy muy nervioso por la entrevista.
wrong: Estoy muy contento por la entrevista.
Estoy muy aburrido por la entrevista.
Soy muy nervioso por la entrevista.
q_vocab_a1_15_006.explanation: 'Nervioso' significa 'nervous'. We use 'estar' (not 'ser') perché nervousness è a temporary state.

q_vocab_a1_15_007.question: Che cosa significa 'enfadado' in 'Mi padre está enfadado conmigo'?
q_vocab_a1_15_007.explanation: 'Enfadado' significa 'arrabbiato'. La frase significa 'Mio padre è arrabbiato con me'. In America Latina è più comune 'enojado'.

q_vocab_a1_15_008.question: ¿Cómo estás? — Estoy bien, gracias.
q_vocab_a1_15_008.correct: How are you? — I am fine, thank you.
wrong: How are you? — I am bad, thank you.
What is your name? — I am fine, thank you.
How are you? — I am tired, thank you.
q_vocab_a1_15_008.explanation: 'Bien' significa 'fine' o 'well'. 'Estoy bien' è il/la standard positive response a '¿Cómo estás?'.

q_vocab_a1_15_009.question: Il tuo friend got a surprise birthday party. Come sarebbe tu describe il loro reaction?
q_vocab_a1_15_009.explanation: 'Sorprendido' significa 'surprised' e 'emocionado' significa 'excited/thrilled'. Both use 'estar' per temporary states.

q_vocab_a1_15_010.question: Il tuo colleague says loro avere nothing a do a work. Quale parola best descrive come loro feel?
q_vocab_a1_15_010.explanation: 'Aburrido' significa 'bored'. Its opposite è 'ocupado' (busy). Quando someone ha nothing a do, loro feel 'aburrido'.
